pages.text: Tier tokens are the primary currency of the progression system. They are used in tier-gated crafting recipes and as quest rewards for gate quests.$(br2)$(bold)Four token tiers:$(/bold) $(t1)Tier 1$(end) (iron-colored) · $(t2)Tier 2$(end) (steel-blue) · $(t3)Tier 3$(end) (amethyst) · $(t4)Tier 4$(end) (gold)$(br2)$(bold)Token fragments$(/bold) drop from structure chests. Collect $(bold)5 fragments$(/bold) to craft a full token.

$(bold)Where Tokens Come From$(/bold)$(br2)$(li)$(bold)Structure chests$(/bold) — fragments and full tokens in dungeon loot$(li)$(bold)Boss kills$(/bold) — 1–4 tokens depending on tier and boss$(li)$(bold)Quest rewards$(/bold) — gate quests grant 3–5 full tokens$(li)$(bold)Transmutation recipes$(/bold) — 8 lower-tier tokens → 1 higher-tier token$(br2)Tokens are $(italic)not$(/italic) required to advance tiers — completing a quest path does that automatically. Tokens are for crafting.

$(bold)What Tokens Buy$(/bold)$(br2)Tier tokens are consumed in recipes for:$(br2)$(li)Tier-gated crafting stations (e.g. $(thing)Apotheosis$(/thing) Gem Cutting Table requires $(t2)T2$(end) tokens)$(li)Waystone construction$(li)$(thing)Class Altar$(/thing) construction$(li)Reforging tokens (basic, advanced, ultimate)$(li)Advanced cross-mod alloy recipes$(br2)They are not currency — they are a crafting material. You will not accumulate excess if you play actively.
